integrity: The orbit bijection is an ordinary marked-quotient argument using Hall universality and inner ultrahomogeneity. The subgroup formulas are classical and explicitly treated as prior; the verifier checks only finite combinatorial consequences.
scientific_limitations: The normal-subgroup/marked-quotient deduction is short once Hall's inner ultrahomogeneity is available, so unindexed folklore is a residual originality risk. Birkhoff's formula, Galois numbers, and their finite-abelian subgroup interpretation are not claimed as new.
title: Normal-subgroup orbit profiles in Hall's universal group
